messages:
emma_cs: Heads-up — Acadia replied to our vendor form, asking us to turn off embedding retention for PII found in their logs. They called it an onboarding blocker and said it affects their procurement approval process.

raj_se: can you paste the exact ask?

emma_cs: sure — excerpt below from their security team: 
```
We require a per-tenant opt-out for embedding/persistent storage of any text containing direct identifiers (SSN, bank acct, driver license). If not possible, we will need contractual carve-outs and proof this is enforced.
```

lina_legal: thanks. high level: we can offer an addendum to the DPA restricting embeddings retention and require a technical control to demonstrate enforcement. we'll need the data flow diagram and a short attestation for SOC2 evidence.

ben_eng: technical options: 1) scrub on ingest (remove PII) 2) opt-out flag on API so we never write embeddings for that tenant 3) store embeddings in tenant-scoped, short-lived store and rotate keys.

raj_se: which is fastest to ship as a mitigation? we need something customers can point to in procurement while we work on the permanent fix.

ben_eng: quick mitigation = opt-out flag + audit log. we can support an API param like:
```json
{"retain_embeddings": false, "retain_embeddings_reason": "pii_exclusion"}
```
Server-side we just skip persistence and return ephemeral embeddings. Audit log entries for the request id + tenant id. estimate: 1 sprint for a scoped rollout (feature flag).

emma_cs: Acadia said they'll pause rollout unless we can show a plan within 2 weeks. they want a stop-gap they can reference in their security review.

lina_legal: we can draft an addendum that references the opt-out technical control and includes a 90-day roadmap for a hardened implementation. need a one-page attestation template for SOC2 evidence — I can draft if you (eng) confirm the behavior and timeline.

ben_eng: confirm we can deliver opt-out + audit logging behind a feature flag in ~10 business days if we prioritize. long-term we should do KMS-scoped storage + per-tenant retention policy.

emma_cs: perfect — i'll tell Acadia we have a temporary control and a legal addendum draft in 2 weeks. can someone own the customer comms and the assignees? @raj_se can you be eng lead? Lina can own legal draft?

raj_se: I'll own the eng scope and create a small PRD with acceptance criteria today. will tag for code review.

lina_legal: I'll start the addendum draft and the one-page SOC2 attestation.

onboard-bot: status update: Acadia onboarding ticket #ONB-2247 moved to "blocking: retention requirement" — eskew ETA: 14 days.

emma_cs: thanks team. i'll sync with the customer and push for any temporary exceptions in their procurement queue. pls add any blockers in the PRD thread. :thumbsup:

raj_se: adding TODOs — integration tests, audit log schema, feature-flag rollout plan, docs snippet for customers.

ben_eng: quick note: need product signoff for exposing `retain_embeddings` param publicly or mark it for enterprise only behind auth.

emma_cs: noted. i'll loop in product if needed. thanks all :eyes:
